On top half, Only a towel wrapped around their neck hanging down if that'd be OK

But still covers the important bits.
Only wearing some mature underwear bottoms on bottom half.


At least knee-up visible.

Give them both very large chests.
And nice hips/legs.

It's a vague idea.
So feel free to change any elements except the characters to whatever you think would make the best image!

https://drive.proton.me/urls/JJ05WTXVAM#ucOveY012Mrr
